passed_checks.check_name: Ensure KMS key policy does not contain wildcard (*) principal
code_block:
DatabaseBackupKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Ref KeyDescription
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: 'Enable IAM User Permissions'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: 'Allow Database Backup Services'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - backup.amazonaws.com
                - rds.amazonaws.com
                - dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService': !Sub 'backup.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: 'Allow Key Administration'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Create*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
              - 'kms:Enable*'
              - 'kms:List*'
              - 'kms:Put*'
              - 'kms:Update*'
              - 'kms:Revoke*'
              - 'kms:Disable*'
              - 'kms:Get*'
              - 'kms:Delete*'
              - 'kms:TagResource'
              - 'kms:UntagResource'
              - 'kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion'
              - 'kms:CancelKeyDeletion'
            Resource: '*'
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      MultiRegion: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref KeyAlias
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: 'Database Backup Encryption'
